# ByTheRank

> Product rankings computed from published specs, with the math shown

Every ranking here is computed from published specifications with weights we state on the page, so you can check the math and re-rank for your own priorities. We don't list prices, which change daily: check the retailer for the current one.

## Rankings

- [Best air purifiers for smoke, ranked mainly by certified smoke CADR](https://bytherank.com/best-air-purifiers-for-smoke/): updated 2026-11-01, next refresh 2026-12-01; data [CSV](https://bytherank.com/data/best-air-purifiers-for-smoke.csv) [JSON](https://bytherank.com/data/best-air-purifiers-for-smoke.json)
